notes.title: Playtest Patch 0.24
notes.notes:
Added full map screenshot feature available from pause menu / F3  
 Reduced the price of some items in the shop  
 Balanced random run to have less nonviable starts

notes.title: Playtest 0.23 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Features

 Added mode selection screen, random run  
 Added drag build, enjoy improved QoL in endless and otherwise  


Content

 Added dirt wand, ice wand, toxic waste for painting tile types  


Changes

 Seed pods moved to rare  


Bug Fixes

 Fixes to do with hatchet and pickaxe not making enough gold

notes.title: Playtest Update 0.18 - Introducing Graveyard
notes.notes:
System Changes

Relics are now limited to 10 slots
Items can be banished from build bar and relic slots
Rarity system added - Common, Uncommon, Rare determining shop appearance frequency
Healing is uncapped


Balance

Rebalanced many shop prices
Lion's mane now gives 50% XP per mushroom
Fruit basket / Fishing hook now give 2 gold


New Upgrades

Gnome Statue
Cotton
Daisies
Huckleberries
Tavern
Corn
Magic Beans
Bodhi Tree
Hatchet
Pickaxe
Prayer Beads


Changed Maps

Wild Cactus added to desert
Some waves changed on swamp, desert to increase QoL


New Maps

Graveyard map added with necromancer & zombie goblins


Polish

Main menu screen now responds to biome
F2 Take Screenshot key
Tooltips added to level screen

notes.title: Playtest Version 0.12
notes.notes:
Shop now only shows 3 items
 Adjusted waves on forest
 Upgrades now prioritized by longest time since seeing rather than completely random
 Landmine buffed cost down to 3g
 Armor reworked into block chance rather than flat damage reduction
 Price reductions on bamboo, lantana, manure and pumpkin in the shop

notes.title: Patch Notes for Playtest 0.11
notes.notes:
Patch Notes 0.11

Balance

 Desert waves adjusted
 Kingsguard nerfed to 10hp
 Armour nerfed to 5hp
 Slowed Kingsguard
 Reduced road bonus
 Spear attack speed nerfed
 Wheat nerf - 6g to build
 Made some prices cheaper: pumpkin, manure
 Starting gold increased
 Sunflower nerf - 3g to build
 Added item limit to build bar - 10 items
 Shop now stocks 4 items


Content

 Blood Chalice - gain $2 when losing life
 Bone Chimes - gain $2 when using banish
 Wedding Ring - for cluster of 2 gnomes, their attack cooldown resets the other one's cooldown


Polish

 Defeat screen juiced
 Added screen shake
 Goblin King HP bar added


Features

 Speed control buttons during night
 Idle gnome button
 Center camera button
 Moved undo button and put shop where it was
